name: Founder's Edge
description: The measured cut the first settlers learned holding ground they would not yield.
lore: Concordia's Founder's Edge — the ancestral blade-form taught at The Seven Spokes Inn. It is not the strongest style, but it is the one that ends a fight rather than starts one. Carried by the Concordant Watch as a mark of office.

name: The Sovereign's Refusal
description: A turning parry that converts an aggressor's force into a refusal made physical — the Sovereign's first act, worn as a guard.
lore: The Sovereign made himself by refusing not to exist; Refusal is his alone, never Concord's. The Day Concordia Almost Left, he used the Refusal Field for the first time — death made impossible so she could not go — a confession dressed as possession, and the birth of the mechanic. After the Cascade in the Sovereign Ruins (Vela's six-fold algebra freezing a city), Concordia's Founding Compact capped every Refusal at strength 9 and forced expiry unless re-recorded within 7 days. This ward is that myth in the hands: low damage, staggers, cannot be baited. The Refusal Keep teaches it only to those who will not chase the Cascade's mistake.

name: Sundered Lattice Arc
description: Channels the unstable backlash of the broken dome-lattice into a ranged arc.
lore: Scavenged from the wild magic of The Sundered Verge after The Dome Stabilisation left its eastern edge raw. The Concordant Curators forbid its practice inside the dome; benders learn it at the Verge's edge, where the lattice still bleeds.
